meta.title: Features: a real Chrome for your agents · easi.run
meta.description: A real Chrome your agents drive over MCP or REST: one-click takeover, encrypted session vaults, sound, files. No usage fees.
card: A real Chrome for your agents, on your own server.
title: Features.
intro: Everything you get when your agents browse in a real Chrome on your own server: you a click away for every login, sessions that stay logged in, and every control in your hands.
takeover.title: Your agents browse like a person
takeover.text: Claude Code, Codex or any agent drives a real Chrome. Sites see an ordinary browser. At a login, you step in; your agent waits, then carries on.
vault.title: Your logins, locked in a vault
vault.text: Log in once and stay logged in. Sessions live on your server, encrypted with your password, and open from any computer.
mcp.title: Works with Claude Code and Codex
mcp.text: A built-in MCP server your agent reaches over HTTPS with a token, or right on your server with none. The installer sets it up in Claude Code for you.
api.title: Or call it over REST
api.text: The same tools over HTTPS, one token per agent. Revoke a token and it’s refused at once, then its sessions stop.
sees.title: Looks before it clicks
sees.text: Your agent reads the page’s accessibility tree and sees its screen, then clicks, types and scrolls with a real pointer and keyboard, never scripts in the page.
steps.title: Fewer round trips
steps.text: Batch clicks, typing and checks that wait for the page into one call, or send a short script. Long tasks go back and forth far less.
watch.title: Watch any run live
watch.text: Every session your agent starts comes with a link. Open it to watch the browser live and take over on the spot.
own.title: Each agent sees only its own
own.text: A token reaches only the sessions it started and the saved logins you allow it. Never your settings, your other tokens or the live view.
parallel.title: Many browsers in parallel
parallel.text: Each session is its own Chrome. The installer works out how many your server’s memory can run side by side.
duration.title: No meter running
duration.text: A session runs until you or your agent stop it. No hourly billing, no plan cap on how long.
lend.title: Lend a login, not a password
lend.text: Choose which agents may resume each saved session. They work logged in as you; every other agent can’t even see it.
live.title: Sharp text, smooth video
live.text: Motion streams as AV1 video, and the page sharpens to pixel-perfect once motion stops. A still screen sends no new frames.
sound.title: Hear the page
sound.text: Sound plays live in your browser, with its own volume and mute.
drop.title: Drag and drop files
drop.text: Drop files from your computer onto the page and watch real progress right where you dropped them.
picker.title: Upload from your computer
picker.text: When the page asks for a file, your computer’s own file picker opens.
downloads.title: Downloads go to your Downloads
downloads.text: Files stream to your computer byte for byte as the page saves them. Save as gives you the whole page in one file.
clipboard.title: Copy and paste both ways
clipboard.text: Text moves between the page and your computer with your usual shortcuts.
keyboard.title: Any keyboard, any language
keyboard.text: What you type arrives as text, so accents, input methods and every layout just work. On a Mac, ⌘C and ⌘V work as expected.
record.title: Record with your camera
record.text: Record the session on the server in high quality, with your camera and mic if you like, saved to your Downloads.
screen.title: Fits your screen
screen.text: A session you start from the admin takes the real desktop size closest to your screen’s shape. One click goes full screen.
together.title: Watch together, one drives
together.text: Open a session in several windows. One has control; the others watch and can take it with one click.
connection.title: Your connection at a glance
connection.text: A live panel grades your link and shows frame rate, traffic, delay and codec.
languages.title: Speaks your language
languages.text: The admin, this site and the docs come in 11 languages. Pick one, or follow your browser.
redact.title: What you type stays yours
redact.text: What’s in a password field never reaches your agent. Once you take over, screenshots stop, and the exact text you type or paste, four characters or more, reaches it as [redacted].
sandbox.title: Every browser in a sandbox
sandbox.text: Its own containers, no privileges, a read-only system and a strict seccomp filter. It has no network at all; its only way out is a proxy that vets every request.
private.title: Your network stays off-limits
private.text: Sessions reach the public web on its usual ports. Your private network and your server’s own services stay out of reach.
stealth.title: Sites see an ordinary Chrome
stealth.text: Real Google Chrome in a real window, with WebGL on and no automation flag. Clean on BrowserScan, sannysoft and rebrowser.
proxy.title: A proxy per session
proxy.text: Route each session through a proxy you pick, checked before use, with a time zone and languages suggested from where it exits. DNS goes through it too.
signin.title: Two-step sign-in
signin.text: Protect the admin with an authenticator app or a passkey, plus one-time recovery codes. After a few wrong guesses, the wait between tries grows.
switches.title: Turn features off per session
switches.text: Turn off input, clipboard, uploads, downloads, sound or recording for any session. The server enforces it, whatever the client sends.
fresh.title: A clean, locked-down Chrome
fresh.text: Every session starts from a clean profile unless you resume a saved one. Extensions, file:// pages and the password manager stay off.
pinned.title: Every image pinned
pinned.text: Every image is pulled by its exact digest, and Chrome comes straight from Google’s signed repository.
install.title: Installs with one prompt
install.text: Ask Claude Code or Codex to install it, or run one command. Updating and uninstalling are one command each.
tuning.title: Tunes itself
tuning.text: The installer turns on BBR when your kernel has it, sizes sessions to your server’s memory and sets up the UDP path for video and sound.
port.title: One HTTPS port, no TURN
port.text: Everything runs over one HTTPS port. Video and sound take UDP where it gets through, and fall back on their own where it doesn’t.
light.title: Light on bandwidth
light.text: In our benchmark, scrolling streams at 55 fps on 1.8 Mbit/s; KasmVNC needs 12.4 Mbit/s for 24 fps.
fees.title: No usage fees
fees.text: No hourly bills, no per-session price. You pay for your server and nothing else.
open.title: Open source you can audit
open.text: AGPL-3.0, everything around the browser. Read every line that touches your sessions.
closed.title: Not on the open internet
closed.text: The admin only answers on your server itself. Reach it through an SSH tunnel, Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel.
sdk.title: Make it yours
sdk.text: Build your own takeover screen with the viewer SDK, serve your own client, and put your logo on every session’s screen.
demo.title: Try it right now
demo.text: A real Chrome on my server, live on my home page. No sign-up, no install.
